checks: Finite nets and affine-independent tuples produce inner polytopes at the same bases. The fibers of their lifted hull are sandwiched between the inner and original fibers. The approximation retains nonemptiness and exact lattice projection P.
Depth continuity gives a strict approximate witness before choosing N. Central normalization preserves depth, actual compatibility and each positive-fiber facet count.

At a positive-volume limit the common interior ball makes all sufficiently late approximants full-dimensional, so the N-facet condition applies to them. Their unit normal rows and touching offsets have a finite joint limit.

The limiting inequality intersection contains the Hausdorff limit. Every row has uniform slack at q, so moving any point of that intersection toward q makes all inequalities strict and certifies it in the late approximants. Closure then gives equality and at most N facets.
The proof uses 21db6cba533d25dc §§1–2. It does not rely on the different deletion or common-plane stress argument in its §3.
